name: Randy
source:
Russell's best friend, he looks up to the ambitious jock but isn't above giving him a hard time.

Randy lives his life moment to moment, doesn't sweat the small stuff, and tackles every situation that comes his way with humor. Often his jokes are more groan-worthy than hilarious, but he doesn't seem to mind either reaction, as he takes neither himself nor the world around him seriously. His flppancy can be grating at times, and just underneath his nonchalant exterior is a heart prone to deep bruising when conflicts can't just be laughed away. He's a lovable slacker, but his reliance on booze and weed to keep his spirits high in the murder-house might make him a liability sooner than later.
